title: MC Helden Ultimate
description: Minecraft Helden Ultimate is a feature-packed PvP survival plugin with custom hearts, elimination mechanics, teams, bosses, events  and much more. Unlock additional premium features with a valid premium license.
body:
# ❤️ Minecraft Helden Ultimate

> ⚡ The ultimate Minecraft Helden-inspired PvP experience for PaperMC 1.21+

## 💎 Premium Version

Premium licenses are available through our official communities:

### 🔹 Official Development Discord
https://discord.gg/pxSJynZC6X

### 🔹 PluginHub Discord
https://discord.gg/M4BZCVm5EG

---

# ⚔️ What is Minecraft Helden Ultimate?

Minecraft Helden Ultimate is a highly advanced PvP survival plugin inspired by the popular Minecraft Helden format.

It combines a modern heart system, eliminations, teams, bosses, events, statistics, and premium features into one powerful and optimized plugin.

Unlike traditional heart-based plugins, Minecraft Helden Ultimate focuses on providing a complete gameplay experience with maximum customization and performance.

> ⚠️ Minecraft Helden Ultimate is a fan-made community project inspired by Minecraft Helden and is not affiliated with the original creators.

---

# ❤️ Heart System

The heart system is the core of the entire gameplay experience.

### Features

- Configurable starting hearts
- Configurable maximum hearts
- Heart loss on PvP death
- Heart statistics
- ActionBar heart display
- Heart management commands
- Complete heart logging system
- Database storage

---

# ☠️ Elimination System

Players are automatically eliminated when reaching 0 hearts.

### Features

- Automatic elimination (ban or spectator)
- Spectator mode support
- Temporary elimination
- Permanent elimination
- Broadcast messages
- Discord logging
- Elimination history
- Database tracking
- Configurable elimination actions

---

# 👑 Boss System

Fight powerful custom bosses with unique abilities and rewards.

### Included Bosses

- Ender Titan
- Nether Lord
- Shadow King
- Void Beast
- Ancient Dragon

### Boss Features

- Custom abilities
- Custom AI
- Custom drops
- Special rewards
- Difficulty settings
- Server-wide announcements
- Statistics integration

---

# 🎉 Event System

Keep your community active with built-in events.

### Included Events

- King Of The Hill (KOTH)
- Supply Drops
- Loot Crates
- PvP Tournaments
- Treasure Hunts
- Last Survivor
- Boss Events
- Seasonal Events

### Event Features

- Automated scheduling
- Custom rewards
- Broadcast system
- Statistics tracking

---

# 📊 Statistics System

Track every important player action.

### Statistics

- Kills
- Deaths
- Hearts gained
- Hearts lost
- Eliminations
- Boss kills
- Event wins
- Team statistics
- Playtime

---

# 🚀 Premium Features

Unlock even more functionality with Premium.

### Premium Includes

- Discord Integration
- Web Dashboard
- Cloud Backups
- Cross Server Synchronization
- Premium Statistics
- Premium Events
- Premium Bosses
- Premium Seasons
- Premium GUI Editor
- Premium Team Features
- Premium Placeholders
- Premium Cosmetics
- Premium API Extensions
- Premium Support
- Future Premium Updates

---

# 🔧 Technical Information

### Compatibility

- PaperMC 1.21+
- Java 21+
- Folia Support

### Storage

- MySQL
- SQLite

### Performance

- Async database operations
- Optimized for large servers
- Production ready
- Modular architecture
- Fully configurable

---

# 📚 Developer API

Minecraft Helden Ultimate includes a developer API for custom integrations.

### Included Events

- PlayerLoseHeartEvent
- PlayerGainHeartEvent
- PlayerEliminatedEvent
- TeamCreateEvent
- TeamWarEvent
- BossSpawnEvent

Perfect for developers who want to extend the plugin with custom features.

---

# 🌟 Why Minecraft Helden Ultimate?

Minecraft Helden Ultimate is more than just another heart plugin.

It provides a complete PvP survival framework with advanced mechanics, custom bosses, team gameplay, events, statistics, and premium systems while remaining highly configurable and optimized.

Whether you're creating a private SMP, a content creator event, or a large public network, Minecraft Helden Ultimate gives you everything needed to build a unique and engaging experience.

❤️ Built by the community, for the community.
